description:
The men of the tribe where ‘Lia’ lives on Gapa Island are worthless unless they have thick bodies and big breasts. In particular, the prettier the color of the nipples, lips, and genitals are pink, the more valuable the product is, which is also a prerequisite for Douttuumnam. One day, ‘Lia’ went hunting and got lost, and as night fell, she ended up in danger. ‘Rikito’ comes to the rescue. Rikito received all kinds of love from women because of his naturally beautiful genitals, but it became a trauma and he lives in hiding in the mountains. The two meet for the first time and fall in love…
